remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Information from O'Keeffe, May 3, 1946. Painted 1943." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "not finished." Whitney Archive indicates, "In the country (I suppose at Lake George)." O'Keeffe wrote: "Today painted a new "White Place" — out of my head" (O'Keeffe to Maria Chabot, 13 March 1943). See cat. no. 1939. "In the country" probably means that the work was stored at Lake George in 1946, when Irvine was compiling the catalogue. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
